name: 56264 · Minneota, MN
findings: ZIP 56264 (Minneota) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (67% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 56264 (Minneota) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 56264 (Minneota) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).
